# Step 2.102: the look of sign-in, the account pages and SR Leagues' own pages

Design note. SR Leagues' own look, never a league's: `platformDesign` (`apps/web/src/features/shell/standalone-page.tsx`, T-325), the neutral design's colors (pale page, white panel, one blue) with a serif (`gelasio`) for titles, served as `/standalone.css` to every page that belongs to no league.
The form card (`packages/ui/src/styles/form-card-css.ts`, `ui-form-card` on `.ui-message`): centered, about 420 wide, a blue rule on top, a kicker ("SR Leagues"), a serif title (28 on a phone, 36 above), labels above full-width fields 44 high, one main button filled blue, quiet links beneath, space 16 to 48.
One colour lands: the blue (main button, top rule, kicker rule, the ways on). Shared pieces: `SubmitButton` (`kind` main or second), `OrLine`, `EmailField`/`PasswordField` (`ui-field`, `ui-field-row`), `.ui-apart` (a block set apart by a hairline), `.ui-rows` (rows with hairlines, no bullets).
Part 2 (builder 2): SR Leagues' own pages (front, find a league, start, help, contact, status, terms, privacy) on the same design value; the form card is for forms only.

## Part 1

Done (8a4944a9): sign in, sign up, code, choose password, forgotten and confirm password, "already signed in", the account page and its problem page, all in the form card. "Sign out" (outlined) and "Sign out everywhere" (its own block under a hairline) stand apart.
Mid-game: the tracker's sign-in link now carries `problem=backToYourGame` (was `signInAgain`): "Sign in again to go back to your game. What you entered is kept on this device.", drawn calm in blue, not as refused (`data-sign-in-problem`).
Checks: typecheck, check, prettier; vitest (sign-in, shell, ui, messages, app) 368; test:web 263; browser: web-exit 332, sign-in-says 81, bot-check-box 41, test-copy-says 54, ask-first 152, coach-finds-team 101, find-their-way 83 (was 73), scoring-trouble 60, refusal 70, nothing-unfinished 2369, harmful-text 2058, terms-privacy 92, test-copy 50, script-policy 112, kept-emails 17.
No check removed or loosened. find-their-way gains: forgot, code and mid-game screens 44 high, no sideways scroll, and the mid-game words. The standalone.css route test points at `platformDesign` and gains a check that its colors are the neutral design's.
Section 4 (pictures `.local/shots/2.102/<390|1280>-platform-{signin,signin-again,signin-refused,signup,signup-code,forgot,account}.jpg`, before in `before/`): 1 yes; 2 yes; 3 n/a; 4 yes at 390, 320 not pictured; 5 yes; 6 n/a; 7 yes (390-platform-account); 8-15 n/a; 16 yes (1280-platform-signup); 17 yes; 18 n/a; 19 yes; 24 yes; 27 yes; 26, 28 n/a.
Section 4, line 22: yes, except that a refusal sits just above the form's fields, not attached to one field. Line 25: yes, but contrast was not measured (`--measure` not run).
Not verified: the design review (section 6) not run; no pictures of choose-password, confirm-password, "already signed in" or the account problem page (they need a flow or a state), none right to left. The serif titles also reach the not-found and no-access screens (same stylesheet).
Decisions: T-325 only. No product wording was invented, so A-20 is not used.
Builder 2 starts at `apps/web/src/app/(platform)/page.tsx` (the front page), then terms and privacy, then find, start, help, contact and status. `node scripts/shots.mjs --dev --only=platform-` takes them all; part 1 added platform-signin-again, -signin-refused, -forgot, -signup-code.
